verify-gates-qualification-remote.sh.source:
#!/bin/bash -l
set -euo pipefail
module purge
module load python3/3.12.4
export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS=1 VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS=1
cd /projectnb/welfgr/fereg/runs/cmg-upgrade-20261021/sources/gates-qualification
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, 'bench')
import qualify
root = Path('/projectnb/welfgr/fereg/runs/cmg-upgrade-20261021')
for label in ('qualification', 'qualification-smoke'):
    path = root / 'policy-gates' / (label + '-plan-Linux.json')
    plan = qualify.read(path)
    qualify.verify_sources(plan['execution_sources'])
    for name, expected in plan['files'].items():
        assert qualify.digest(qualify.resolve(path, name)) == expected, name
    output = Path('target/tmp/cmg-upgrade') / (label + '-Linux')
    assert not output.exists(), 'existing output must not be overwritten'
    print(label, 'all', len(plan['files']), 'file bindings and', len(plan['execution_sources']),
          'execution modules verified', qualify.digest(path))
(root / 'policy-gates/qualification-job-logs').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
print('REMOTE_QUALIFICATION_PREFLIGHT_COMPLETE')
PY
